**{{< var days.d1.question >}}**

Day 1 starts from counting words and ends at attention. Each module fixes a specific weakness of the one before it, and the same small datasets run through all four labs so you can measure the improvement.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Before Day 1: [Module 0 · {{< var modules.m00.title >}}](lectures/00-coding-agents.qmd), optional pre-work.** On your own laptop, you install a terminal coding agent, build two small data apps with it in Python or R, and publish them on GitHub Pages. If you get stuck, bring your laptop to the optional drop-in clinic from 08:00 to 09:00, before the 09:00 welcome. Nothing later in the workshop depends on it.
:::
